quests.question: Every student who enrols in the programme receives tailored one-to-one tutoring.
quests.sentence: Every student who enrols in the programme receives tailored one-to-one tutoring.
quests.hint: What does every student receive? Tailored tutoring - but who provides it? The programme provides; 'receives' means students are the object... Actually: the subject 'every student' receives tutoring - but this IS the active receiver! Wait: 'every student RECEIVES tutoring' - the student is the subject receiving. That's more like passive in meaning but active in grammar since 'receives' is the main verb and student is the subject acting (receiving is an active verb here).
quests.explanation: Simple present active. 'Every student' (subject) + 'receives' (active verb) + 'tailored tutoring' (object). 'Receives' is an active verb here - the subject actively obtains something.
